title: Output during a partial input scan
statement: Let $M$ be a Turing machine with no work tapes, let $q$ be a state, and suppose that in state $q$ each input bit is copied to the output while the input head moves right and the state remains $q$, and a blank input symbol causes the machine to emit nothing and halt. For every Boolean word $x$, output word $o$, and $j\le |x|$, after $j$ steps from the scan configuration at position zero in state $q$ with output $o$, the machine is in state $q$ at position $j$ and its output is $o$ followed by the first $j$ entries of $x$.
hypotheses_covered: For every input and work-tape reading, the transition in state $q$ has the specified behavior
